sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You will not lose your cool today despite the overwhelming odds, feels Ganesha. Rationale and reason will be the rhyme of your attitude as you diagnose the problems and uproot them successfully. Success beckons and you are ready to reach out and grab it by hook or by crook. Guard your reputation as your ethics might come under the scanner, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Some books you've been reading lately might excite your desire to study astrology, numerology, alchemy, or some other occult science, Taurus. This may not be something that you'd normally consider, but don't let that hold you back. Your values have been shaken up lately anyway, so make the most of the impulse now. It could transform you in a subtle way. Go for it!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: You may get frustrated by people who don't seem to respect your time and energy, dearest Taurus. As the Pisces Moon forms unbalanced aspects with Jupiter and Mercury, consider putting peers to work if they won't leave you alone. You'll either receive the help you request, or others will take the hint to be on their way. Your imagination runs wild once the Sun aligns with Neptune and Pluto this evening, and you'll be eager to let creativity flow.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: You are likely to maintain a good health today which will give you the success. But you must avoid anything that will destroy your strength. Today, your money can be spent on many things. Hence, you need to plan a proficient budget today so as to tackle all the challenges and money-related problems. A spiritual leader or an elder provides guidance. You and your spouse will create the best memory of your married life today.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that today is just too good to hold an important business meeting with one of your big clients. It will turn out to be very positive and you shall make a pile of money out of it.

You have a time of communication in order to exchange ideas. This can be very conducive to starting a new career or advancing in the one you have. All that's required is to be true to yourself. Aspects affecting communication make you a little quirky and unique. You don't care what others think, which makes it so much easier for you to ask for what you're worth.

Today's planetary alignment gives you the ability to see yourself for the good, beautiful person that you are! If you have been tending to your needs and paying close attention to yourself (mindful eating, exercise, and sleep) you will feel especially good. If you have been feeling guilty because you've been distracted and neglecting your body, such a benevolent aspect reaches deep into your core and spreads its healing rose-gold light.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Prioritizing responsibilities over fun is not wise -- make room for playtime today.
